title: Satmar Rebbe Visits New Halls
body: Satmar Rebbe Rav Zalman Leib Teitelbaum toured two grand event halls in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, nearing completion for the Satmar community.

title: Rabbis Protest Draft Law
body: Dozens of rabbanim and chassidishe rebbes met in Yerushalayim to oppose the proposed draft law, calling it an existential threat. They announced a mass rally in response.
